title: Card Replacement Cost Recovery on Add-On Fee Refunds
content:
**Q. What is the card replacement cost recovery?**
A. An amount taken off the refund of a removed business add-on card's fee on a Northgate Memberships business membership, for replacement cards recently issued on the membership. The refund never goes below zero.

**Q. What is the rule?**
A. Replacement cards issued on the membership for a lost, stolen or damaged card in the three months before the refund carry a card replacement cost recovery of 10.00 dollars when there are two or more, 5.00 dollars when there is one, and nothing when there is none.

**Q. Which cards count?**
A. Card issuances on the membership whose reason is the replacement of a lost or stolen card or of a damaged card, dated fewer than three whole months before the refund. New cards for added cardholders are not replacements.

| Replacement cards issued in the three months before the refund | Card replacement cost recovery |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10.00 |
| 1 | 5.00 |
| none | nothing |

**Q. Hypothetical: one replacement for a stolen card and one for a damaged card, both in the last two months?**
A. Two replacements — 10.00.

**Q. Hypothetical: one replacement issued four months before the refund?**
A. Outside the three months — nothing.
